map.若 g=6%：P=2.12/(0.10−0.06)=53 元。增长率小幅提升显著: If g = 6%: P = 2.12/(0.10−0.06) = 53 CNY. A small rise in growth pushes the valuation up sharply (the denominator is sensitive).
map.r−g 为负或接近 0 怎么办？: What if r − g is negative or close to 0?
map.模型要求 r>g，否则估值发散无意义。高成长股 g 接近 r 时结果极不稳定，不: The model requires r > g, otherwise the valuation diverges and is meaningless. When g approaches r for a high-growth stock the result is extremely unstable and this model should not be used.
map.本工具为 Gordon 单阶段。高成长公司应分阶段（前高增、后稳定）贴现，否则低: This tool is the single-stage Gordon model. High-growth companies should be discounted in stages (high growth first, then stable), otherwise they are undervalued.
map.戈登增长模型（DDM）：P = D₁ ÷ (r − g)（元）；联动量：贴水率: Gordon growth model (DDM): P = D₁ ÷ (r − g) (currency units); linked values: spread = r−g, dividend yield = D₁ ÷ P ×100 (%), earnings-multiple upper reference = 1 ÷ (r−g). Validation: non-empty guards for all three fields; the code does not intercept r−g = 0, and the division-by-zero result falls back to “—” in rendering. Criteria: no fixed grading; the model only applies when r > g and dividends grow steadily.
